backends.description: List of backend servers (web applications) to proxy to. Each must have at least name, host, and port.

host.description: IP address or hostname of backend server

port.description: Port the backend service listens on

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for connection establishment (optional)

first_byte_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for first byte from backend (optional)

between_bytes_timeout.description: Seconds to wait between bytes from backend (optional)

directors.description: Backend pools for load balancing (e.g., 'random', 'round-robin'). Each director references backends by name.

members.description: List of backend members in this director

backend.description: Name of the backend to include (must match a backend.name)

weight.description: Relative weight for weighted balancing (e.g., 'random' with weights)

default_ttl.description: Default cache TTL (seconds) for successful responses (2xx/3xx)

error_ttl.description: Cache TTL (seconds) for client/server errors (4xx/5xx). Shorter to avoid propagating stale errors.

debug_headers.description: Include detailed debugging headers in responses (X-Varnish-Debug). Only enable in non-production environments.

add_x_varnish_headers.description: Add X-Cache (HIT/MISS) and X-Varnish headers to responses. Useful for diagnostics.

add_age_header.description: Preserve original Age header in a custom header before unsetting it (for debugging).

serve_stale_on_error.description: Allow serving stale content on backend errors and enable grace period for revalidation. Improves resilience.

purge_acl.description: List of IP addresses authorized to send PURGE requests. Keep minimal for security.
